alpha: Select alpha>=224structure plus a two-pixel edge allowance; retain actual alpha>=16only within that structural mask. This removes soft generated glow while preserving antialiased edges. Interiors>=240normalized and invisible RGB cleared; branch gaps stay transparent.
fruit_ownership: Red-dominant pixels R-G>=12,R-B>=12,R>=30 identify fruit. Six connected opaque components (alpha>=224) establish fruit count; faint red antialias islands do not create extra fruit. Both primary and fruit roles are neutralized.
rejected_extraction: The first alpha>=16red-component diagnostic counted detached translucent red halos as extra fruit. That script is retained as register-tree-rejected-red-islands.py. Actual opaque-core comparison resolves exactly six fruit; selected output also excludes detached halos.
source_limit: Six glyph groups are authored fruit marks, not native harvest count. Native yield remains1. Branch texture is authored from description, and actual native primary tint remains g.
registration: Whole1024x1536image maps once to256square, shared by both harvest tints. Neither state is independently centered or rescaled.
omitted_views: Fixed-view plant does not require creature turnarounds, clothing or secondary facing. Ripeness is a source-defined color change with shared geometry.
